title: Deformation of the shells and summation of the deformed series (Simon 6.5.1, (11)–(25))
statement: Deformation of a decomposed current and summation of the deformed series (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (11)–(25)). Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (VO): the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support (S(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from spt S). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let push_k(F, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), homot_k(F, G, X) ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) be operations (k ∈ ℕ, F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), domain univ) satisfying (PF), the conclusion of the frozen type of the parent's sibling Submission.cmcdt_lipschitz_pushforward_homotopy for this P (taken verbatim as a hypothesis): calling X normal with compact support (NC) when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for k ≥ 1, 0 for k = 0), for all Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, all Λ-Lipschitz F, G, F', G' and all NC X, Y of degree k: (1) push_k(id, X) = X; (2) push_k(F, X − Y) = push_k(F, X) − push_k(F, Y) and homot_k(F, G, X − Y) = homot_k(F, G, X) − homot_k(F, G, Y); (3) if F = F' and G = G' on spt X then push_k(F, X) = push_k(F', X) and homot_k(F, G, X) = homot_k(F', G', X); (4) M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X), spt push_k(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X), M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ(2Λ)^k M(X) whenever δ ∈ ℝ and |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X, and spt homot_k(F, G, X) ⊆ {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ spt X, t ∈ [0, 1]}; (5) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞: ∂ push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X), push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂ homot_{k+1}(F, G, X), and if X is integer multiplicity then push_{k+1}(F, X) and homot_{k+1}(F, G, X) are integer multiplicity; (6) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^P) with compact support and finite mass, push_0(G, X) − push_0(F, X) = ∂ homot_0(F, G, X). Assume also (IMS), the conclusion of the frozen type of the parent's sibling Submission.cmcdt_im_series for this P (taken verbatim as a hypothesis): for every k ∈ ℕ and all W_i ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ, domain univ) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ (tsum in [0, ∞]) there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) such that: for every test form ω, the series Σ_i W_i(ω) has sum S(ω) (HasSum); M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i); spt S ⊆ closure(⋃_i spt W_i); and if every W_i is integer multiplicity then S is integer multiplicity. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), W_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P), φ_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, Λ_j ∈ ℝ≥0 (j ∈ ℕ), δ ∈ ℝ and L, A, A' ⊆ ℝ^P, and assume: Σ_j W_j(ω) = T(ω) (HasSum) for every ω; ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} − (Z_{j+1} − Z_j); every W_j is integer multiplicity; spt W_j, spt D_j, spt Z_j are compact, M(W_j), M(∂W_j), M(D_j), M(Z_j) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn D_j ℝ^P, boundaryMassOn Z_j ℝ^P < ∞; φ_j is Λ_j-Lipschitz, 1 ≤ Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}; φ_{j+1} = φ_j on spt Z_j; dist(φ_j(x), x) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt W_j ∪ spt D_j ∪ spt Z_j; L is closed and φ_j(x) ∈ L for x ∈ spt W_j; spt W_j ⊆ A and spt D_j ⊆ A'; Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j) < ∞, Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j) < ∞ and (2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j) → 0 (in [0, ∞]). Then there are Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), S₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with: Q₀ and R₁ integer multiplicity; T − Q₀ − S₁ = ∂R₁; spt Q₀ ⊆ L ∩ cthickening(δ, A), spt R₁ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A), spt ∂Q₀ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A'), spt S₁ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A') (Metric.cthickening); M(Q₀) ≤ Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j), M(∂Q₀) ≤ Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j), M(R₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j) and M(S₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j) (δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary, ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, dη = exteriorDerivativeTestOn U k η, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative η); currents are equal when their values agree (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support (Simon 6.2.11) = U minus the zero region, the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity: X is represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of the contract (R.carrier, R.mult, R.orient), i.e. X(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ, and R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
